about_the_game:
Dead by Backrooms Anomaly

Why does a woman enjoy darkness? The thrilling adventure of a woman in love within a mysterious atmosphere. Everything is so different and captivating. To fall so deeply in love for the sake of this tension requires madness. A funny yet suspenseful love story.

Among psychological horror games, this one offers a unique storytelling experience that will both scare you and make you laugh. Through small simulations and puzzles, you must unravel the mysteries of this intriguing story. Its dark and realistic structure provides an intensely atmospheric experience. By overcoming locked doors and unexpected moments of terror awaiting you, you’ll find yourself lost within the depths of the story.

What Awaits Me In This Game?

  • A different kind of horror experience.

  • Events where you’ll experience full-on suspense.

  • Entertaining simulation elements.

  • A wild storytelling approach.

  • Absurd and unconventional comedic plot twists.

Why Should I Purchase This Game?

  • I’m developing games on my own and need a budget for more polished productions.

  • I need new models, plugins, and sounds.

  • Since I make unconventional games, I’m struggling to find support.

  • I want to continue game development as a profession.

I’ll move as fast as I can for the development and expansion packs of Dead by Backrooms Anomaly. This way, you’ll be able to continuously feel the fear.
